_note: P&H HC filing examples for Draft Generation prompt. text_file = extracted text for use in prompts.

CWP.label: Civil Writ Petition (CWP) — Article 226
CWP.notes: Real P&H HC CWP filed in 2010. Includes index, memo of parties, list of dates, petition body, prayer, verification.

CRWP.label: Criminal Writ Petition (CRWP) — Habeas Corpus / Article 226 Criminal
CRWP.notes: Real CRWP filed before P&H HC in 2018. Good example of habeas corpus / illegal detention petition structure.

CRM-M_BAIL.label: Regular Bail Application (CRM-M) — Section 439 CrPC / Section 483 BNSS
CRM-M_BAIL.notes: Real CRM-M bail petition from P&H HC 2023 (Hussain Abbas v State of Haryana). Shows standard format: case details, grounds, prayer.

CRM-M_ANTICIPATORY.label: Anticipatory Bail (CRM-M) — Section 438 CrPC / Section 482 BNSS
CRM-M_ANTICIPATORY.notes: 48-page comprehensive guide by Former District Judge SS Upadhyay (2026). Contains full draft formats for anticipatory bail u/s 438 CrPC and 482 BNSS. NOTE: BNSS applies for FIRs on/after 1 July 2024.

CRM-M_QUASHING.label: FIR Quashing Petition (CRM-M) — Section 482 CrPC / Section 528 BNSS
CRM-M_QUASHING.notes: Proforma for compromise quashing before P&H HC. Includes required documents list, format of petition, and compromise deed.

CRM-M_BAIL_CANCEL.label: Bail Cancellation (CRM-M) — Section 439(2) CrPC
CRM-M_BAIL_CANCEL.notes: Real P&H HC bail cancellation order (21 pages). Shows structure of bail cancellation petitions.

CIVIL_SUIT.label: Civil Suit Plaint — CPC Order VII
CIVIL_SUIT.notes: DU Law Faculty 140-page reference covering plaints, written statements, and all civil pleadings under CPC. Use for district court civil suits.

phc_format_requirements.paper: One side only, plain watermarked paper or legible computer print
